CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION softmax(v vector(384), temperature double precision)
RETURNS float8 AS $$
SELECT EXP(v[1] / temperature) / SUM(EXP(e / temperature) FOR e IN (SELECT unnest($1)));
$$ LANGUAGE sql;
